routes.name: Stay Permit (extension of stay for business visa holders)

note: Myanmar. The Ministry of Immigration and Population's own sites didn't answer from here on 2026-10-30 (no connection), so this file rests on Myanmar's own schedule of specific commitments on the movement of natural persons under the ASEAN-Australia-New Zealand Free Trade Area (Annex 4, as amended by the Second Protocol; the schedule dated 27 April 2023, published by the AANZFTA secretariat), which states the visa and stay rules all foreign enterprises and workers abide by. Business visas give 70 days (single entry) or 3, 6 or 12 months (multiple entry); a foreigner holding a business visa extends the stay by a Stay Permit, applied for by the employing company, verified by the responsible ministry and submitted to the Ministry of Immigration and Population, which issues the Stay Permit and a re-entry visa valid 'no more than 12 months' (a ceiling, so no term is kept); the schedule doesn't say where the person must be when it is asked, so where to apply isn't written. The schedule notes that workers and staff working at least a year in Myanmar may be taken as resident foreigners. No fee (only overstay penalties, US$3 a day to 90 days and US$5 after), decision time, renewal rule or work right is stated; the work permit and the Foreigners Registration Certificate aren't written. The schedule is the government's own text, though issued through a treaty; the Ministry's notices weren't read.
